meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把回复变成先给下一步、步骤编号、带时间估计的清爽格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果长回复总让你走神,希望每条建议都能立刻动手。
copy.tagline_en: Turn replies into numbered next steps with clear time estimates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if long answers lose you and you want a clear next step every time.

howto.what: Claude 会去掉寒暄和结尾客套，回复第一行先给能立刻做的下一步动作，多步任务编成编号清单，每轮重述进度，给具体时间估计，并把已完成的结果明确写出来。
howto.when: 输入 /i-have-adhd 后接管所有回复，包括写代码、调试和闲聊，一直生效直到你说 “stop adhd mode”。

say.text: /i-have-adhd 接着帮我修这个登录报错
say.note: 开启后回复先给下一步动作

say.text: 把这个重构任务拆成编号步骤，标出每步大概花多久
say.note: 多步工作会写成编号清单
关闭该模式，恢复正常回复

howto.what_en: Claude drops greetings and sign-offs, opens with a next action you can do now, numbers multi-step work, restates progress each turn, gives concrete time estimates, and spells out what now works.
howto.when_en: Turns on with /i-have-adhd and shapes every reply — coding, debugging, casual chat — until you say "stop adhd mode".

say_en.text: /i-have-adhd now help me fix this login error
say_en.note: Replies lead with the next action

say_en.text: Break this refactor into numbered steps with time estimates
say_en.note: Multi-step work becomes a numbered list
